related.title: Cassini-Huygens 土星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付力向量、功率假設、殘差及模型不可識別項，不以擬合好壞單獨宣告新物理。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver force vectors,power assumptions,residuals and identifiability limits without inferring new physics solely from fit quality.
related.difference: 設計探測資料收集、緩衝與中繼的時序帳，檢查輸入輸出速率不匹配。
related.differenceEn: Design a probe-data acquisition,buffer and relay ledger and test mismatched input/output rates.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先求 F=2×10⁻⁷ N，再除質量，核對 W/c 的力單位。
算前段 3.6 Mbit，再算後段淨增 2.4 Mbit，與總量式核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate F=2×10⁻⁷ N,divide by mass and verify that W/c has force units.
Compute 3.6 Mbit before relay and 2.4 Mbit net increase afterward,checking the total formula.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Mars Pathfinder 火星探路者
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付力向量、功率假設、殘差及模型不可識別項，不以擬合好壞單獨宣告新物理。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver force vectors,power assumptions,residuals and identifiability limits without inferring new physics solely from fit quality.
related.difference: 在輪速與影像位移之間建立滑移估計，不把馬達轉動當作實際行進。
related.differenceEn: Estimate slip from wheel motion and image displacement instead of equating motor rotation with travel.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先求 F=2×10⁻⁷ N，再除質量，核對 W/c 的力單位。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學小車輪半徑 0.065 m，轉 10 圈，影像量得前進 3.2 m。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：s=1−3.2/(2π×0.065×10)。 結果約 0.216468 fraction。滑移率 s=1−實際距離/輪周理論距離；僅適用前進且理論距離非零的段落。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate F=2×10⁻⁷ N,divide by mass and verify that W/c has force units.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. A model rover has 0.065 m wheel radius, ten revolutions and 3.2 m visual displacement. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: s=1−3.2/(2π×0.065×10). Result ≈ 0.216468 fraction. Slip s=1−actual travel/wheel-implied travel applies to forward segments with nonzero wheel travel.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
